question: Why do some locate valid cognition in the subtle elements?
premises: Some accept the subtle elements as the locus of valid cognition.
They appeal to rules such as the eye-ray not making contact.
These considerations are used to support cognition at the subtle-element level.
inference: The subtle elements are proposed as the operative basis of cognition because direct sensory contact is questioned.
uncertainties: The referenced rules are only indicated by 'and so on' and not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: Others accept the subtle elements as the means of cognition, appealing to rules such as the claim that the eye-ray makes no contact.
